summary: Frontend testing of loan management admin app completed. Login flow, dashboard, loans tab, transactions tab, and client details page all load correctly. Fixed 3 critical issues: (1) Missing ActivityIndicator import in dashboard index.tsx, (2) Duplicate catch block in loans.tsx, (3) Duplicate catch block in transactions.tsx. data-testid attributes exist in source code but are NOT rendered in web DOM by React Native Web.

issues: data-testid attributes defined in source code (e.g., 'confirm-payment-btn', 'toggle-lock-btn', etc.) are NOT rendered to HTML DOM. React Native Web strips custom props like data-testid. This affects automated testing capability.

action_items: CRITICAL: data-testid attributes are NOT being rendered to the web DOM. React Native Web requires using 'testID' prop which maps to 'data-testid' only when using specific configuration. Consider using 'accessibilityLabel' or 'nativeID' props which DO render to DOM.
The auto-refresh race condition fix in client-details.tsx (using useRef isModalOpenRef) is correctly implemented.
Verify date-fns dependency is properly installed if date validation issues occur.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Missing ActivityIndicator import in /app/frontend/app/admin/(tabs)/index.tsx - caused app crash after login
Fixed: Duplicate catch block in /app/frontend/app/admin/(tabs)/loans.tsx (lines 86-92) - syntax error preventing bundle
Fixed: Duplicate catch block in /app/frontend/app/admin/(tabs)/transactions.tsx (lines 94-98) - syntax error preventing bundle
data-testid props in React Native components are NOT transferred to web DOM by react-native-web. For web testing, use accessibilityLabel which becomes aria-label in DOM, or nativeID which becomes id.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all pages load correctly after fixes
